title: mcp-vs-cli-bench: an open benchmark for MCP versus CLI tool use across agent scaffoldings and models
description:
An open, re-runnable benchmark comparing tool use over the Model Context Protocol against tool use over a command-line interface, across four agent scaffoldings (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, qwen-code, pi) and models spanning hosted frontier systems and locally-served open weights.

One fixed workflow with five independently checkable sub-answers is run twice per scaffolding/model pair, once with a GitHub MCP server attached and once with the scaffolding's native shell. Each run records initial context size, total and cached tokens, tool-call count and a register of which tools were called, tool-call success, percentage of the task completed against a rubric, a theoretical cost from one public price list applied uniformly, and wall time.

The repository contains the harness, the task and rubric, the scaffolding adapters, the cost model, the proxy configuration, and the raw run logs, so every published number can be re-derived.
